A custom data_as_elements list names the elements to convert

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using HtmlToMarkdown;

var result = HtmlToMarkdownConverter.Convert("<div><section data-as=\"p\">First</section><section data-as=\"p\">Second</section></div>", new ConversionOptions { DataAsElements = new List<string>() { "section" } });
Console.WriteLine(result.Content);
```
